root.label: Jagtar Singh Johal detained in India without conviction

events.label: Jagtar Singh Johal detained in India without conviction

slots.name: detention duration
slots.sentence: Burt has already met Gurpreet Singh Johal, the brother of Jagtar Singh Johal, who has been detained by the Indian authorities for nearly nine years without a conviction.

events.label: Jagtar Singh Johal released from Delhi prison

slots.name: imprisonment duration
slots.sentence: Johal had been in jail for nine years without trial.

slots.name: charges remaining
slots.sentence: While he was acquitted of one terrorism-linked charge in March 2025, eight other charges remain.

slots.name: release date
slots.sentence: British-Sikh activist Jagtar Singh Johal was released from a prison in Delhi on Thursday after the Indian high court warned the government it would be found in contempt of court.

slots.name: court order date
slots.sentence: The court had ordered Johal's release on September 18 and later warned the government against continued attempts to keep him imprisoned.
